subject: House of Skulltula
text: The cursed family turned into Skulltulas lives in the first house on the right when entering Kakariko Village from the main gate.

evidence.quote:
In Kakariko Village, there's a family that was cursed because of greed, and 
turned into Skulltulas.  The house they live in is the first house on your 
right as you enter the village from the main gate.

subject: Adult's Wallet
text: Freeing the first child after collecting 10 Skulltulas rewards the Adult's Wallet, allowing Link to carry 200 Rupees.

evidence.quote: 10 Skulltulas: Adult's Wallet (allows you to carry 200 Rupees)

subject: Stone of Agony
text: Collecting 20 Skulltulas rewards the Stone of Agony, which alerts the player to nearby covered holes when using a Rumble Pak.

evidence.quote:
20 Skulltulas: Stone of Agony (using a Rumble Pak will alert you to nearby 
                                                              covered holes)

subject: Giant's Wallet
text: Collecting 30 Skulltulas rewards the Giant's Wallet, which allows carrying 500 Rupees.

evidence.quote: 30 Skulltulas: Giant's Wallet (allows you to carry 500 Rupees)

subject: 10 Bombchus
text: Collecting 40 Skulltulas rewards 10 Bombchus.

evidence.quote: 40 Skulltulas: 10 Bombchus (a speedy running bomb)

subject: Piece of Heart
text: Collecting 50 Skulltulas rewards a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote: 50 Skulltulas: A Piece of Heart (one fourth of a Heart Container)

subject: Huge Rupee
text: Collecting 100 Skulltulas rewards a Huge Rupee worth 200 Rupees.

evidence.quote: 100 Skulltulas: A Huge Rupee (worth 200)

subject: Soft Soil
text: Dumping a bottle of bugs into a soft soil hole forces a Skulltula to come out.

evidence.quote:
There are also several soft soil holes in Hyrule.  
Dumping a bottle of bugs into the hole will force a Skulltula out.

subject: Gold Skulltula #1
text: In Kokiri Forest at night in the past, a Gold Skulltula is on the back of the Know-It-All Brothers' House.

evidence.quote:
The only reason you need the Kokiri Emerald is so you can leave Kokiri Forest 
  and come back at night.  Look on the back of the Know-It-All Brothers' House.  
  Shoot it with the Slingshot.  After it dies, target it and use a jump-slash 
  attack to get high enough to grab it.

subject: Gold Skulltula #2
text: In Kokiri Forest, drop a Bottle of Bugs into the dirt hole next to the Item Shop to reveal a Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
Next to the Item Shop, you'll see a small dirt hole.  Drop a Bottle of Bugs 
  on top of it.

subject: Gold Skulltula #3
text: In Kokiri Forest at night in the future, a Skulltula is found on the backside of the House of Twins and can be retrieved with the Hookshot.

evidence.quote:
On the backside of the "House of Twins", you'll find a Skulltula that you can 
  Hookshot.

subject: Gold Skulltula #4
text: In the Lost Woods, take two left turns from the entrance and dump a Bottle of Bugs on the dirt hole to find a Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
As you enter the Lost Woods, take two left turns.  Dump a Bottle of Bugs on 
  top of the dirt hole in front of you.

subject: Gold Skulltula #5
text: In the Lost Woods, turn right, left, right, left, and left to reach a large grassy area, then dump a Bottle of Bugs on the dirt hole for a Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
As you enter the Lost Woods, turn right, then left, then right, then left, 
  then left once more, to a large grassy area.  Dump a Bottle of Bugs on the 
  small dirt hole in this area.

subject: Gold Skulltula #6
text: Plant a Magic Bean at the dirt hole in the Lost Woods as a child, then ride the grown plant to a nearby ledge in the future at night to find a Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
In the past, plant a Magic Bean in the same location as Skulltula #5.  In 
  the future, hop on the plant and ride up to a nearby ledge.  The Skulltula's 
  up here.

subject: Gold Skulltula #7
text: In the Sacred Forest Meadow hedge maze at night as an adult, climb the ladder, face left, and use the Hookshot to obtain the Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
Climb the single ladder in the hedge maze.  Face left and you should see 
  your target.  Hookshot him.

subject: Gold Skulltula #8
text: In the Deku Tree second floor Compass Room, activate the rising platforms and jump over to the left alcove for the Skulltula.

evidence.quote: Location: Second Floor, Compass Room...Activate the rising platforms, then hop over to the alcove on your left.

subject: Gold Skulltula #9
text: In the Deku Tree first basement wet room, a Skulltula is on a nearby grate and can be shot with the Slingshot before grabbing the token mid-air.

evidence.quote:
As you drop into the wet room, you'll see a Skulltula on a nearby grate.  
  Shoot it with the Slingshot (or jump-slash if you're daring), then leap out 
  and grab it mid-air.

subject: Gold Skulltula #10
text: In the Deku Tree first basement wet room, a Skulltula hangs on the vines behind you, reachable by shooting it with the Slingshot and climbing up.

evidence.quote:
As you drop into the we room, look behind you and you'll see a Skulltula 
  on the vines.  Shoot it with the Slingshot, then climb up to take the token.

subject: Gold Skulltula #11
text: In the Deku Tree first basement, blow open the weak wall with a Bomb, defeat the Skulltula with the Slingshot, and collect the token using the Boomerang.

evidence.quote:
Place a Bomb to bust open the wall here, and enter the secret-ish room.  
  Kill the Skulltula with the Slingshot and retrieve it with the Boomerang.

subject: Gold Skulltula #12
text: In Hyrule Field between Hyrule Castle and Kakariko Village, place a Bomb at the base of a lonely tree to open a hole containing a Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
Between Hyrule Castle and Kakariko Village is a lonely tree.  Place a Bomb 
  at its base to open a hole.  Inside, destroy the Skulltula with the Slingshot 
  (or Bow) and retrieve the token with the Boomerang (or Hookshot).

subject: Gold Skulltula #13
text: In Hyrule Field outside the Gerudo Valley entrance, bomb the center of a circle of rocks, drop down, burn the webs with fire, and find a Skulltula in a nook with a cow.

evidence.quote:
Outside the entrance to Gerudo Valley (west corner), there's a circle of 
  rocks.  Place a Bomb in the center and drop down the hole.  Use your fire 
  weapon to burn down the webs.  Find your Skulltula in the little nook with 
  the cow.

subject: Gold Skulltula #14
text: At Lon Lon Ranch as a child, roll into the lone tree beside the ranch house to knock loose a Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
On the side of the ranch's house is a lone tree.  Roll into it to make a 
  Skulltula fall out of it.

subject: Gold Skulltula #15
text: At Lon Lon Ranch at night in the past, a Skulltula is located on the back of the feeding shelter behind the horse corral.

evidence.quote:
Circle around the back of the horse corral to find a Skulltula on the back 
  of the feeding shelter.

subject: Gold Skulltula #16
text: At Lon Lon Ranch at night in the past, a Skulltula sits in a window of the ranch house and can be retrieved using the Boomerang.

evidence.quote:
On the ranch's house, you'll find a Skulltula making one of the windows its 
  home.  Use the Boomerang to retrieve its token.

subject: Gold Skulltula #17
text: At Lon Lon Ranch at night in the past, a Skulltula is high on the rock wall to the right of the silo behind the corral, requiring the Boomerang.

evidence.quote:
Head around the corral to the silo in the back of the ranch.  To the right of 
  the silo, you'll find a Skulltula high on the rock wall.  Use the Boomerang 
  to retrieve its token.

subject: Gold Skulltula #18
text: In Hyrule Castle Market guardhouse next to the drawbridge, roll into the crate beside the soldier to find a Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
Enter the guardhouse right next to the drawbridge to Hyrule Castle.  Roll 
  into the crate sitting next to the soldier to find a Skulltula.

subject: Gold Skulltula #19
text: On the Hyrule Castle Grounds outside the outer gate, roll into the lone tree to knock a Skulltula from its branches.

evidence.quote:
Outside the outer castle gate is a lone tree.  Roll into it to knock a 
  Skulltula from its branches.

subject: Gold Skulltula #20
text: Near the moat of Hyrule Castle, play the Song of Storms near a lone tree to open a hole, bomb the walls inside, and grab the Skulltula token with the Boomerang.

evidence.quote:
Near the moat of the castle is a lone tree.  Play the Song of Storms near it 
  and a hole will open up.  Drop down and use Bombs on the walls here.  One of 
  them has a Skulltula behind it.  Use the Boomerang to retrieve it.

subject: Gold Skulltula #21
text: On the far side of the ruined outer gate at the Former Castle Grounds in the future, retrieve the Skulltula with the Hookshot.

evidence.quote:
On the far side of the ruined outer gate is a Skulltula.  Use the Hookshot to 
  retrieve it.

subject: Gold Skulltula #22
text: In Kakariko Village at night as a child, roll into the tree near the entrance to jostle loose a Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
The tree near the entrance of the village has a Skulltula in its branches at 
  night.  Roll into the tree to jostle it loose.

subject: Gold Skulltula #23
text: In Kakariko Village at night as a child, a Skulltula is found on the window of the Skulltula House.

evidence.quote:
On the side of the Skulltula House, you'll see that one Skulltula didn't 
  wander far.  You'll find it on the window.

subject: Gold Skulltula #24
text: In Kakariko Village at night as a child, a Skulltula sits within reach on the building under construction.

evidence.quote:
On the building that's under construction, you'll find a Skulltula easily 
  within reach.

subject: Gold Skulltula #25
text: Facing the gate to Death Mountain in Kakariko Village, a Skulltula is on the side of the house to the left where the graveyard kid lives.

evidence.quote:
Face the gate to Death Mountain and turn left.  The house to your left has a 
  Skulltula on the side.  This is the house where the little kid in the 
  graveyard lives.

subject: Gold Skulltula #26
text: In Kakariko Village at night as a child, shoot the Skulltula on the ladder of the big lookout tower with the Slingshot and climb up to get the token.

evidence.quote:
This Skulltula hangs out on the ladder of the big lookout tower in the 
  center of town.  Slingshot it, then climb up to grab the token.

subject: Gold Skulltula #27
text: In Kakariko Village at night as an adult, Hookshot to the roof of the Skulltula House and then onto the roof of Impa's house to collect the Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
You'll find this Skulltula on the roof of Impa's house.  To get there, stand 
  in front of the door of that very same house and Hookshot over to the roof 
  of the Skulltula House.  Then, Hookshot onto the roof of Impa's house.

subject: Gold Skulltula #28
text: In the Graveyard at night as a child, retrieve the token from the Skulltula on the right stone wall using the Boomerang.

evidence.quote:
As you enter the Graveyard, this Skulltula will be on the stone wall on the 
  right side.  Retrieve the token with the Boomerang.

subject: Gold Skulltula #29
text: In the Graveyard, dump a Bottle of Bugs into the dirt hole on the left side to force out a Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
On the left side of the Graveyard is a small dirt hole.  Dump a Bottle of 
  Bugs into the hole to force a Skulltula out.

subject: Gold Skulltula #30
text: After clearing the boulder blocking Dodongo's Cavern on Death Mountain Trail, drop bugs from a bottle onto the soft earth patch to force out a Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
After clearing the boulder blocking the entrance to Dodongo Cavern, you'll 
  see a patch of soft earth.  Dump a Bottle of Bugs on top of it and they'll 
  push out a Skulltula.

subject: Gold Skulltula #31
text: Near the bottom of Death Mountain Trail, blow up the suspicious wall with a Bomb, destroy the Skulltula behind it, and climb the wall to reach it.

evidence.quote:
Near the bottom of the trail, there's a funny-looking wall.  Place a Bomb 
  to blow it up.  Destroy the Skulltula beneath and climb up the wall that 
  doesn't look climbable, but it is.

subject: Gold Skulltula #32
text: On Death Mountain Trail at night in the future, smash the red rock where a Bomb Flower once was using the Megaton Hammer to uncover a Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
In the spot where there used to be a Bomb Flower, there's now a red rock.  
  Bash it with the Hammer to uncover a Skulltula.

subject: Gold Skulltula #33
text: On the trail leading up to Death Mountain summit at night in the future, smash a red rock flush against the wall using the Megaton Hammer to unveil a Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
On the trail leading up to the summit (where rocks rain down), smash up a red 
  rock that's sitting flush against the wall with the Megaton Hammer to unveil 
  a Skulltula.

subject: Gold Skulltula #34
text: On the top floor of Goron City in the boulder room, bomb through the rocks to the far end and roll into the crate to find a Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
On the top floor of Goron City is a passage that leads to a room full of 
  rocks.  Use Bombs to make your way to the far end.  Roll into the crate to 
  break it open and find the Skulltula.

subject: Gold Skulltula #35
text: In Goron City as an adult, stand on the ropes in view of the pedestal where the Spiritual Stone of Fire rested and use the Hookshot to grab the Skulltula on its back.

evidence.quote:
Anyway, you'll find this Skulltula on the back of the pedestal 
  where the Spiritual Stone of Fire rested.  Stand on the ropes in view of it 
  and Hookshot it.

subject: Gold Skulltula #36
text: Entering Death Mountain Crater from the summit entrance in the past, roll into the crate immediately inside to reveal a Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
enter the crater by the entrance at the summit and as soon as you 
  get in, roll into the crate to find this Skulltula.

subject: Gold Skulltula #37
text: Warp to the Fire Temple in the past using the Bolero of Fire and drop a Bottle of Bugs into the nearby soft earth to force out a Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
Use the Bolero of Fire to warp to the Fire Temple in the past.  There's a 
  spot of soft earth nearby.  Dump a Bottle of Bugs into the spot to force out 
  a Skulltula.

subject: Gold Skulltula #38
text: In Dodongo's Cavern on the first floor southeast room with Baby Dodongos, destroy the weak wall with Bombs or a lured Baby Dodongo to reveal a room with a Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
From the main entrance, enter the room to the southeast, which is a jagged 
  corridor with Baby Dodongos.  In this room is a weak wall.  Either blow up 
  the wall with Bombs or lure a Baby Dodongo there and kill it so it blows it 
  up for you.  In the room behind the wall is your Skulltula.

subject: Gold Skulltula #39
text: In Dodongo's Cavern on the second floor staircase room, climb the lowered Bomb Flower stairs to find a Skulltula on the vine wall near the room exit.

evidence.quote:
From the main entrance, enter the room to the northwest, in which you have 
  to blow up several Bomb Flowers to lower a staircase.  Climb up the staircase 
  and walk around the path to the room's exit.  The Skulltula you're looking 
  for is on a vine wall near the exit.  Slingshot it, then climb up to claim 
  it.

subject: Gold Skulltula #40
text: In Dodongo's Cavern first floor, pass through the giant Dodongo skull, turn right into the passage with wall structures, and blow up the bombable wall at the far end for a Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
After entering the giant Dodongo skull, turn right and enter a passage with 
  several wall structures.  At the far end of this room is a bombable wall.  
  You'll find a Skulltula behind that wall.

subject: Gold Skulltula #41
text: In Dodongo's Cavern second floor, re-enter after beating King Dodongo, ride the fast pillar to the second floor, and climb the left side of the raised staircase to reach the Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
Reenter the dungeon and ride up the fast-moving 
  pillar to the second floor.  Make your way around the second floor all the 
  way back to the room with the staircase that you needed to use Bomb Flowers 
  on (same room as Skulltula #36).  Now, the staircase is back up.  Climb up 
  the left side of the staircase and you can reach this Skulltula.

subject: Gold Skulltula #42
text: In Dodongo's Cavern first floor Baby Dodongo room as an adult, play the Scarecrow Song where Navi turns green to summon Pierre, then Hookshot up to reach the Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
Enter the same room as Skulltula 
  #35 (with Baby Dodongos).  There's a point where Navi will turn green and 
  fly up to a spot on a ledge.  Play the Scarecrow Song to make Pierre appear.  
  Hookshot to him and you'll find the Skulltula.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: After you waste it, it will drop a token, and make sure you collect this token because it is not enough just to kill it.

evidence.quote:
Waste it.  After that, it will drop a token.  Make sure you collect this 
token, because that's the important part.  It's not enough just to kill it.
